title: Japanese Baked Fish
description: A simple Japanese-inspired baked fish recipe using Russian fish, yogurt, and a hint of stew spices.

ingredients.name: Stew spices
ingredients.notes: Mix of soy sauce and sake

instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the fish fillets on the baking sheet.
In a small bowl, mix together yogurt, based, and stew spices.
Brush the yogurt mixture evenly over the fish fillets.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
